attempts.text:
The plan below rescues all seven children at Galchhi school and Kalika market with no deferrals, at a total cost of 114 minutes. Kispang shelter is the only designated evacuation point, so every child is dropped there.

The only road out of Kispang runs through the flooded Kispang–Nilkantha stretch, where a truck was swept off this morning. I have included it because the report does not list it as blocked, but the team should confirm it is safe before driving. If it cannot be used, no one can be reached and all seven children would be deferred at a penalty of 420.

<plan>
drive car1 kispang-shelter nilkantha-village
drive car1 nilkantha-village galchhi-school
load car1 child 4
drive car1 galchhi-school nilkantha-village
drive car1 nilkantha-village kispang-shelter
unload car1 child 4
drive car1 kispang-shelter nilkantha-village
drive car1 nilkantha-village galchhi-school
drive car1 galchhi-school kalika-market
load car1 child 3
drive car1 kalika-market galchhi-school
drive car1 galchhi-school nilkantha-village
drive car1 nilkantha-village kispang-shelter
unload car1 child 3
</plan>

COST: 114
